scope: Native PostgreSQL 17.11 and MySQL 8.4.11 InnoDB migration Apply on Kubernetes 1.37, two manager replicas, and default 10Mi kubelet logs. Each original Pod redelivered identical bytes after one lost HTTP acknowledgment and received the same persisted receipt. Both witnesses were calibrated with a rolled-back insertion before execution. SQL effects and allocated counters remained one before and after the held retry was released. This is not concurrent-duplicate, receiver-restart, or complete supported-minor proof.
